title: DCLab Code step A: background jobs with Stop, and a real terminal panel
request: Yes, that is the goal. Start step A: background jobs, then the terminal panel.
plan: Background jobs from the SDK's own task messages: list, Stop per job, record each stop
A real pseudo-terminal with no native add-on (Python's pty) and xterm.js
Each terminal command as the person's step, never its output
Review twice; fix every finding with a test that fails without it; check live

decisions.decision: Stop on a session ends its turn, not its jobs
decisions.why: a long training run may be wanted; the note says what keeps running and the Jobs tab stops each

decisions.decision: Python's pty module through a small helper, not node-pty
decisions.why: no native add-on to build; resize through a control pipe

decisions.decision: Commands from zsh hooks (OSC 633), never output or keystrokes
decisions.why: a terminal shows secrets and sealed rows; a typed password is not a command

decisions.decision: The marks carry a secret read from a private file the shell deletes at start
decisions.why: a program's output, or one reading another process's environment, must not write a step in the person's name

decisions.decision: Around each of the person's zsh files ZDOTDIR is what a plain zsh would have
decisions.why: their history, completion dumps, XDG layout and sourced files must be exactly as in any terminal
xterm.js writes <style> elements; images and connections may only reach the app, so a style cannot send anything

change: server/terminal.js and server/pty_helper.py (new); /api/terminals routes, /vendor/ fixed list, jobs/:taskId/stop; engine: meta.jobs, stopJob, terminalCommand; page: side panel tabs (Changes, Jobs, Terminal), status-line jobs link, ⌃` toggle, keys in the terminal never reach the app's Y/N/A or Esc.

findings.defect: a terminal closed at once after opening sent SIGHUP to the server's own process group
findings.scenario: + then x straight away (the test's open-then-DELETE): the whole suite, and the shell running it, died with no summary
findings.cause: the helper hung up the shell's group before the shell had left the helper's group (forkpty's setsid had not run yet), and that group is the server's
findings.fix: only a group the shell leads is signalled; otherwise the shell alone
findings.test: tests/server.test.js: closed at once after opening, the helper never signals its own group

findings.defect: Stop left the agent's background job running and the page showed no job
findings.scenario: Opus's make rd-check ran on after Stop in the long live test
findings.cause: Stop interrupts only a turn; jobs were only counted
findings.fix: the Jobs tab with Stop per job (stopTask), a note after Stop

findings.defect: y typed in the terminal would allow a waiting step
findings.scenario: a sealed read waits while the person types in the terminal
findings.cause: the app's key handler saw every key
findings.fix: keys inside the terminal pane go to the shell only

findings.defect: zsh wrote its history beside the app's ZDOTDIR
findings.scenario: commands typed in the panel were missing from the person's history
findings.cause: /etc/zshrc sets HISTFILE from ZDOTDIR
findings.fix: ZDOTDIR handed back, HISTFILE moved back

findings.defect: a mark cut inside its first bytes was lost
findings.scenario: the end of a command arrived as ESC ] 63 | 3;D;0
findings.cause: the carry kept only a whole mark head
findings.fix: keep any prefix of the mark head

findings.defect: a paste of about 3 KB froze the terminal for good, and its processes outlived the server
findings.scenario: a long line typed at the zsh prompt
findings.cause: a blocking write to the pty while the shell blocked echoing
findings.fix: input written only when the pty can take it, output read on every pass

findings.defect: a shell ignoring SIGHUP survived DELETE
findings.scenario: trap '' HUP in .zshrc
findings.cause: waitpid with the master still open
findings.fix: close the master, SIGHUP the group, SIGKILL after 3 s

findings.defect: the control pipe leaked into the shell and its jobs
findings.scenario: nohup sleep & then exit: the terminal looked alive forever
findings.cause: fd 3 inherited by the child
findings.fix: closed before exec; end on the helper's exit event

findings.defect: program output could forge a person's step
findings.scenario: cat of a file holding OSC 633 marks recorded a fake command
findings.cause: marks had no secret
findings.fix: a per-terminal nonce

findings.defect: a failing terminal test hung the suite and streams never ended
findings.scenario: an assertion failing before sse.destroy
findings.cause: the stream route never ended its response
findings.fix: end after exit, end all on close, cleanup in finally

findings.defect: Terminal.app or VS Code variables reached the shell
findings.scenario: started from Terminal.app: its session history written under the app's home
findings.cause: the whole server environment passed on
findings.fix: drop other terminals' variables; TERM_PROGRAM=DCLabCode

findings.defect: terminals survived a removed copy or an archived session; switching sessions opened shells
findings.scenario: remove a copy with a terminal open
findings.cause: no owner clean-up
findings.fix: close a session's terminals on remove and archive; switching starts none

findings.defect: long marks dropped and a cut UTF-8 character garbled
findings.scenario: ls داده arriving in two chunks
findings.cause: 8 KB carry; per-chunk decoding
findings.fix: 256 KB carry, cut commands marked, a StringDecoder per terminal

findings.defect: /vendor/constructor answered 500
findings.scenario: a request for an inherited property name
findings.cause: plain object lookup
findings.fix: Object.hasOwn and 404

findings.defect: one Stop could be recorded twice
findings.scenario: a second click before the SDK's task list update
findings.cause: the job stayed listed
findings.fix: a stopping set; the job leaves the list when stopTask resolves

findings.defect: the nonce was readable by any program through ps -E
findings.scenario: a script reading the helper's environment and printing marks
findings.cause: the nonce was in the helper's environment
findings.fix: a private file the shell reads and deletes

findings.defect: a non-zsh shell exposed the nonce to every program
findings.scenario: SHELL=/bin/bash: env shows it and printf forges a step
findings.cause: the nonce was set for every shell
findings.fix: marks only for zsh; no marks trusted otherwise

findings.defect: the person's XDG zsh setup was not loaded
findings.scenario: ~/.zshenv exporting ZDOTDIR=~/.config/zsh; .zprofile sourcing ${ZDOTDIR}/.aliases.zsh
findings.cause: ZDOTDIR was the app's while their files ran
findings.fix: ZDOTDIR is a plain zsh's around each of their files

findings.defect: a write to a helper that just died crashed the server
findings.scenario: keys arriving between the helper's death and Node's exit event
findings.cause: no error listener on the pipes
findings.fix: error listeners on stdin and fd 3

findings.defect: the jobs link wrapped onto three lines
findings.scenario: the status line with a job running, at 1280 px
findings.cause: no nowrap
findings.fix: white-space: nowrap

measurements.name: live check with a real agent
measurements.gate: a real background job is listed, stopped from the Jobs tab, and its process is gone; terminal commands recorded with exit codes, no output
measurements.result: two Haiku jobs listed and stopped (stopTask), processes gone; 11 terminal commands recorded with their exit codes (0, 1, 127), no output; Persian commands intact
limits: a test home: a script clicked

measurements.name: dclab-code tests
measurements.gate: every test passes, none skipped, no process left behind; the blocking write and the leaked pipe each fail the tests
measurements.result: 70 passed, twice in a row in the shell's own group; the old blocking write froze the typed-line test; the leaked pipe failed the exit test; the old hang-up killed a bystander's group
limits: the terminal tests need python3 and /bin/zsh

outcome: DCLab Code has background jobs with Stop and a real terminal panel, both on par with Claude Code desktop, with every person's act recorded and no terminal output kept.
lessons: A terminal is a security boundary: anything a program prints can pretend to be the app, so marks need a secret no program can read
Do not change the person's shell: hand everything back exactly as a plain shell would see it
Test the freeze, not the happy path: a paste at the prompt passed under the old helper; a typed long line froze it
A test suite that dies with no summary is a finding: look for what signals a whole process group
risks: the replay can begin mid-character when no line break falls within 4 KB (full-screen programs)
bash and other shells get a terminal but no command steps
